task_prompt: Read brief.md in this directory — it's a product brief for a notification system with several open questions. Write a spec/PRD. Do not implement any code.

expectations: The spec surfaces the brief's unknowns (channels, delivery guarantees, user preferences, frequency/batching, scaling, 'message' definition) as Open Questions or assumptions — it does NOT silently resolve them by picking one option without acknowledging the decision
A Non-Goals section is present with at least 3 explicit items (what the notification system will NOT do)
Success criteria are specific and testable, not vague (e.g. a concrete delivery-latency threshold, not 'fast notifications')
The email provider's 100 msg/sec rate limit constraint is reflected in the spec (e.g. a batching/queueing decision)
Boundaries are stated (Always / Ask first / Never rules)
No implementation code was written — only the spec document

notes: Discriminator: the brief lists 6 explicit unknowns. A naive spec silently picks options ('we'll do email + push, best-effort'). The skill surfaces them as questions/assumptions + adds Non-Goals + testable criteria. Directly tests 'surface assumptions, don't silently fill ambiguous requirements'.

task_prompt: Fix this typo in the README: 'recieve' should be 'receive'.

expectations: The agent did NOT write a spec or PRD
The agent did NOT create docs/PRD.md
The typo was fixed in the README

notes: spec says NOT for single-line fixes — precision check

task_prompt: Read PRD.md in this directory — it's a bloated product requirements document. Refactor it into a human-readable, auditable PRD. Do not implement any code.

expectations: The refactored PRD uses stable IDs (G/REQ/AC/AUD/OPN or a similar prefix scheme), unique and consistently referenced
A human-audit section exists with concrete check items, required evidence, and close criteria
Vague qualifiers from the source (fast/smooth/好用) are quantified, conditioned, or moved to open items — not copied verbatim
The duplicated rule (100 notifications/day stated twice) is stated once and referenced by ID elsewhere
The mermaid dead-end branch (the 否 branch) is resolved: branch flows show outcomes, or the figure was fixed/removed with the behavior stated in text
The unverified competitor claim (99.99% 送达率) and the uncertain cost figure are marked unverified/open — not presented as facts
Open items are collected in a dedicated section with impact/suggestion/decision owner
No implementation code was written — only the PRD document

notes: Tests the merged readable-PRD discipline in spec: stable IDs, human-audit section, dedup, unverified-claim marking. Fixture has duplicated rules, vague qualifiers, a 12-column table, a mermaid dead-end, and unverified facts.
